description: Ingest data into a KQL table. Inline mode (--data) is limited to ~4MB. For larger files, use storage mode (--source-path) to pull from OneLake or ADLS Gen2 with no size cap.
notes: INLINE: --data 'csv text', --data @file.csv, or pipe via stdin. Constructs '.ingest inline into table [T] <| data' (mgmt endpoint). STORAGE: --source-path pulls from storage via '.ingest into table [T] (h'URL;impersonate') with (format=...)'. Pass either a full https:// OneLake/ADLS URL, OR a lakehouse-relative path with --source-lakehouse <id> (+ optional --source-workspace). The engine reads storage using the caller's identity (impersonate) — no SAS needed. Set --format (Csv|Tsv|Json|MultiJson|Parquet, default Csv) and --ignore-first-record for CSV/TSV headers.

storage_example.command: fabio kql-database ingest --workspace $WS --id $KDB --table payments --source-lakehouse $LH --source-path Files/raw/payments.json --format MultiJson
storage_example.description: Pull a 35 MB JSON file from OneLake into a KQL table. Resolves the lakehouse-relative path to a onelake.blob.fabric.microsoft.com URL and ingests it synchronously via '.ingest into'.
